verdictSummary: The s0081 blocker is real: 贈開府 is a posthumous kaifu grant, not an enfeoffment. The owner patch is approved only with an amended after text, because "opening the Grand Marshalate" keeps the original mistranslation of 開府. The owner pass is incomplete. (1) The same 開府 = "grand marshalate" error repeats in s0006, s0028 and s0091. (2) Its direct extraction dependency was missed: claim index 164 encodes s0081 as an enfeoffment titled "Grand marshalate", and two office labels repeat the error. (3) The literal fields of seven units (s0003, s0026, s0127, s0133, s0178, s0191, s0194) still contain the exact errors the accepted editorial review corrected only in the idiomatic field. (4) Within the clauses being repaired, s0026 renders 尚書令 as "Minister of Works" and 太師 as "Grand Tutor", and s0133 renders 司空公 as "Grand Master of Ceremonies"; the 尚書令 error has propagated into p023's identity surface ("Works Sima Ziru") and alias. All fixes are definite and source-grounded, none is an unresolved contradiction, and the dry-run shows zero chronology content change. Return them together to the owner; this reviewer checks the patch and its dependencies.
